items.tr: I will start the work now.
Everyone, please gather. We will proceed with the pre-work safety inspection meeting.
I will deliver today's work details.
Please check the condition of the machine and tools before starting work.
Please let me know immediately if you experience any physical abnormalities or are not feeling well.
Please move only through the designated passages within the work area.
Please perform the work in order according to the instructions of the work instructor.
Do not arbitrarily operate the machine or change the settings.
Never work alone in a two-person work area.
Please check the location of the power switch and emergency stop button in advance.
Please clear obstacles around the work area and tidy up.
Check if the safety device or protective cover is functioning properly.
Using smartphones and wearing earphones during work is prohibited.
If you discover any risk factors, stop the work immediately and report it.
Shift workers, please check the handover details accurately.
Do not rush during dangerous work, and follow safety regulations.
Please pause the operation.
Ending all tasks for today.
After finishing the work, turn off the machine power and unplug it.
Please put used tools and protective equipment back in their proper places.
It is dangerous! Step back.
Do not touch electrical equipment with wet hands due to the risk of electric shock.
This is a pinch (entrapment) risk zone. Please watch your hands and clothing.
This is a fall hazard zone. Do not lean on the railing.
This is a falling object warning zone. Please always keep an eye on the area above.
A forklift is approaching. Please stop and ensure safety.
Crane lifting operation in progress. Please do not pass under the lifted object.
Caution regarding high-temperature equipment! Do not touch the surface due to the risk of burns.
Caution: Rotating parts! Do not put your hands in while the machine is rotating.
This is a fire hazard zone. Smoking and the use of open flames are strictly prohibited.
This is a toxic gas and suffocation hazard zone. Do not enter the enclosed space without permission.
Caution when handling chemicals! Avoid skin contact and inhalation.
The floor is slippery, so please be careful not to slip when walking.
Bend your knees when lifting heavy objects to avoid injuring your back.
Do not lean on the cargo as there is a risk of collapse and tipping.
Do not perform welding or flame work near flammable materials.
Do not look directly at laser or welding lights with your naked eyes.
Do not expose high-pressure gas containers to impact or direct sunlight.
Be sure to check the pressure status when opening and closing valves and piping.
This is an area with high dust levels. Please turn on the ventilation system.
Do not stand in the passageways for vehicles and heavy equipment.
Do not stack items beyond the loading height limit.
Be sure to check and comply with safety signs and hazard signs.
Do not step on uncertified ladders or unstable platforms.
Please attach a 'Do Not Operate During Inspection' sign during machine inspection.
Be sure to fasten your safety helmet chin strap before entering the workplace.
Be sure to wear safety shoes to protect your feet.
Wear a safety harness and fasten the safety hook when working at heights.
Wear a dust mask or gas mask when working with dust and hazardous materials.
Be sure to wear safety glasses as debris may fly.
Please wear earplugs (hearing protection) in noisy workplaces.
Wearing gloves that may get caught when operating rotating machinery is prohibited.
Wear chemical-resistant rubber gloves and protective clothing when handling chemicals.
Wear a welding mask and leather gloves when welding.
Wear cut-resistant gloves when cutting or handling sharp materials.
Check the protective equipment daily for any damage or breakage.
Replace damaged safety helmets or protective gear with new ones immediately.
Wear a reflective vest when working at night or in dark places.
Please wear heat-resistant and cold-resistant clothing suitable for the work environment.
Please tie your long hair neatly inside your safety helmet.
Please keep loose work clothes or clothing with strings neat, as they may get caught in the machine.
Lower the safety shield and proceed with insulation and grinding work.
Wear insulating gloves and insulating shoes when performing electrical inspections.
Entry to the workplace is restricted if protective equipment is not worn.
After finishing work, wipe the protective equipment clean and store it in the storage box.
If the emergency bell rings, stop work immediately and evacuate.
Press the emergency stop button to stop the machine immediately.
Fire! Shout "Fire!" loudly and alert those around you.
Cover your nose and mouth with a wet towel or clothing, and evacuate while keeping your posture low.
Do not take the elevator; use the emergency stairs to escape.
In the event of a power outage, remain calm and follow the emergency exit signs.
Check the location of the fire extinguisher and pull the safety pin to extinguish the initial fire.
If an injury occurs, notify the supervisor immediately.
If the patient is unconscious, call 119 and perform cardiopulmonary resuscitation.
If chemicals splash into your eyes or skin, wash with an emergency washcloth for at least 15 minutes.
If you suspect a gas leak, do not turn on the light switch; instead, open the windows to ventilate.
Please gather promptly at the designated outdoor assembly point and check the number of personnel.
Do not store items in emergency exits and emergency passageways.
In the event of an earthquake, hide under a sturdy table and protect your head.
In the event of a collapse or falling objects, cover your head and move to a safe place.
In the event of an electric shock, do not touch it directly; cut off the power first.
Do not arbitrarily damage the accident scene and wait for instructions from the manager.
Please cooperate with the guidance of the 119 paramedics and firefighters.
Always be familiar with the location of the first aid kit at the scene.
Please actively participate in emergency evacuation drills.
It is now a 15-minute break.
Please put down your work tools and move to the designated break room.
Heatwave alert! Rest in the cool shade and drink plenty of water.
Cold wave alert! Drink warm beverages and take care to stay warm.
Do not stay in danger zones or near machinery during breaks.
It is lunchtime. Please go to the cafeteria.
Please be sure to wash your hands thoroughly before meals.
Please return to the workplace 10 minutes before resuming work after the meal.
Loosen up your body with light stretching after a break before starting work.
Please maintain silence and keep the lounge tidy.
Please be sure to smoke only in designated smoking areas.
Drinking alcohol and bringing alcohol into the workplace are strictly prohibited.
Work will resume in 5 minutes. Please prepare for work.
Prevent heat-related illnesses by consuming adequate fluids and salt.
We will begin the afternoon work. Please move to your respective positions.
